stem.en: Srivalli buys 1 kg of mangoes when the price is ₹150 per kg. The price falls to ₹50 per kg and she buys 3 kg. Which sentence describes this best?

text.en: Her demand rose, so her whole demand curve moved to the right.
The price fell, so she moved along her demand curve and bought more.
Her purchasing power fell, so she had to buy a larger amount.
She decided to buy more first, and that made the price fall.

explanation.en: Only the price changed, so Srivalli moved along her own demand curve, from A to C. The whole curve moves only when something other than the price changes; the next lesson shows how. Her purchasing power did not fall: at a lower price, her money buys more.

hints.en: What changed first: the price, or something about Srivalli?
